status: method_commitment_before_assay_acquisition; exact memberships and file hashes not yet registered
question: Does source-provided mapped rock class improve buffered regional prediction of quantified stream-sediment copper relative to a fixed spatial interpolator?
exposure: Only catalogue, licensing and metadata definitions reviewed. Separate assay-data workbook has not been downloaded or read. Published sample counts and sampling density are known; no assay values, maps of copper, target distributions or scores were inspected. This is a retrospective public-data experiment, not an externally blinded or prospective trial.

target.method: aqua regia digestion with atomic absorption spectrometry
target.support: sampled stream sediment representing upstream drainage; no depth/ore inference

eligibility.assay: finite numeric Cu_AAS_PPM > 0 only; negative values are source <DL and retained as censored evidence but excluded from this quantified-positive regression; zero and missing values excluded
eligibility.coordinates: finite source NAD83 LAT/LONG within [-140,-114] longitude and [48,61] latitude; transform EPSG:4269 to EPSG:3005 for distances and grouping
eligibility.ids: exclude every row with a repeated MASTERID; exclude every routine stream row sharing coordinates rounded to 5 decimal degrees with another routine stream row; exclusions depend on identity/location, never Cu magnitude
eligibility.geology: join geology_at_sample_site by exact MASTERID; only rock_class used; missing or conflicting class becomes UNKNOWN without dropping samples
eligibility.noOtherAssays: No other element, assay method, mineral occurrence, mine label, economic outcome or test label may be used as predictor

split.group: 50,000 m grid in EPSG:3005; floor(easting/50000), floor(northing/50000)
split.assignment: SHA256 UTF8 of bc-rgs2020-cu-aas-geology-v1|<gridX>:<gridY>; first 8 hex digits interpreted as unsigned integer modulo 100; 0..59 train, 60..79 validation, 80..99 audit
split.buffer: Remove training rows within strictly less than 10,000 m of any validation OR audit location. Remove validation rows within strictly less than 10,000 m of any audit location. Never relocate excluded rows or retry a different seed/grid/buffer. Audit rows remain unchanged.
split.minimum: Each retained partition needs at least 100 samples and 8 spatial groups; otherwise stop without model fitting or changing the protocol.

baseline.configuration: Predict log1p Cu from 50 nearest retained training sites in EPSG:3005 with inverse-squared-distance weights. Break distance ties by sample ID. If fewer than 50 training sites, stop. Exact zero distance uses mean of zero-distance training targets. Fixed k=50 transferred from earlier US soil work; no tuning on BC scores.

candidate.configuration: Fit a mean log1p Cu per source rock_class with shrinkage of 20 pseudo-observations at the overall training mean: (sum_class + 20*globalMean)/(n_class+20). Unknown/unseen class uses the global training mean. Compute training residuals from those class means. Predict class mean plus the same 50-neighbor inverse-squared-distance weighted residuals. Clip predicted log1p Cu below zero to zero. No hyperparameter search.

evaluation.selection: Exactly one candidate, no adaptive search. Generate baseline/candidate validation predictions; commit both audit predictions before computing any audit metric. Score the audit once even if validation gate fails, so failures are recorded without changing the candidate.
evaluation.metric: Sample-weighted RMSE on log1p Cu; also report MAE and number of samples/groups. Relative gain = 1 - candidate RMSE / baseline RMSE.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired spatial-group bootstrap, 2000 resamples with numpy Generator(PCG64(20260917)); sample audit group IDs uniformly with replacement, include all rows in each sampled group with multiplicity, compute aggregate sample-weighted RMSE gain. Use linear 2.5th/97.5th percentiles. This quantifies group-resampling variability, not a calibrated location interval or full source uncertainty.
evaluation.gate: Candidate qualifies only if validation gain >= 0.02, audit gain >= 0.02, audit bootstrap lower bound > 0 and minimum membership checks pass. Otherwise retain spatial baseline and report failure/uncertainty. No deployment to unsampled regions is authorized by passing this gate.
evaluation.budget: Two fixed methods; one audit; no seed, threshold, feature, neighbor-count or shrinkage retuning after scores are observed.

limitations: Target is quantified-positive stream sediment, not the full censored concentration distribution. Exclusion can cause selection bias.
Regional grid/buffers reduce close-site leakage; catchment overlap and broader spatial dependence can remain.
Geology is the publisher supplied 2013 map join. It is not independent truth, may reflect historical geological/geochemical interpretation and is not a historical as-of feature reconstruction.
Laboratory, vintage, survey and preparation differences may remain within AAS data.
Canadian RGS and US DS801/Copperwood are distinct source programs, targets and sample supports. This experiment is not a direct replication of the prior score.
Local commitments and code checks are not external blinding. Keep all exposure history; do not call a newly assigned split prospective.
An improvement or failure in this one experiment does not establish a recursively learned research policy.
implementationRule: Mechanical file/sheet/header adaptations may be documented before any scores without changing scientific choices. Unexpected source semantics, ambiguous identity/units, insufficient membership or unverified rights stop the run for a new reviewed design; do not silently relax conditions.
